summary: DTE Energy completed a $1 billion sale of 6.200% Fixed-to-Fixed Reset Rate Junior Subordinated Debentures due 2058 under an existing shelf registration statement. No equity terms, premium, or board recommendation are disclosed as this is a routine debt issuance. The debentures were issued under an amended indenture with The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company as trustee. This 8-K filing under Items 8.01 and 9.01 is a standard reporting of debt securities takedown and does not represent a special situation such as an acquisition, restructuring, or capital return event.
